name: Barbarian: Thirst for Battle restores Energy when Smash hits a training dummy (#12018)
contract: Thirst for Battle (570236): 'Your Smash now regenerate 25% of your maximum Energy.' A level 60 Barbarian's Smash is rank 8 (501033, no power cost, requires the enrage aura state). The CoA hit hook casts 560463 (SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT 25, Energy) when a Smash hits, but it required damage above 0. npc_training_dummy (32666, the capital-city Training Dummy) sets the damage it takes to 0 in DamageTaken, so Smash on a training dummy never restored Energy (#12018). With ordinary regeneration disabled and Energy set to 0 before each cast, the Energy afterwards divided by maximum Energy is the restored share: 0.25 when the talent works and 0 when it does not. The control hit on an ordinary creature (36) shows the normal path still gives the same 25%. Hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries.
